q: Which region brought in the most money in 2025?
gold: SELECT c.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*p.unit_price),2) v FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many orders did Enterprise clients place?
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.segment='Enterprise' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id=o.order_id)

q: Show me sales broken down by product category
gold: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*p.unit_price),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category

q: What's the revenue from the West in Q1 2026?
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*p.unit_price),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND c.region='West' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'

q: List the customers who have no email on file
gold: SELECT customer_id, name FROM customers WHERE email IS NULL

q: Total quantity of Document AI sold
gold: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND p.product_name='Document AI'

q: What is our customer churn rate this year?
Average order value for South region customers
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*p.unit_price)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND c.region='South'

q: How many SMB customers do we have?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE segment='SMB'

q: Which salesperson closed the most deals?
